title: fix(gates): recognise docs/ and .claude/ path literals, and reconcile the whitelist against turbo.json
body:
Fixes #18342

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

`repoRelativeLiterals()` recognised a repo-relative path literal only when it started at
`packages|apps|examples|content|scripts|skills`, while its own header note promised "every
top-level directory a declared glob can name". The note was false, so a test naming a whole
`docs/...` path inside one quoted string was invisible to the flat collector and this gate
stayed green over an undeclared cross-package read.

## What landed

- The alternation is hoisted into `RECOGNISED_TOP_LEVEL_DIRECTORIES` and the regex is built
  from it, so the list is the single place a directory is added. `docs` and `.claude` join it.
- `turboRootTopLevelNames()` reads back what `turbo.json` actually declares and splits it
  against the **git index** into directories and repo-root files.
- A new self-test battery reconciles the two, so the header note is now checked rather than
  promised: the next top-level directory to gain a `$TURBO_ROOT$` input reds this gate instead
  of arriving unnoticed. Registered in `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES`; floor raised 12 to 13.
- `turbo.json` was read as the criterion and **not modified**.

## Acceptance 2 — the census, taken on this branch's base

Every `$TURBO_ROOT$/...` entry's first segment, against the old whitelist. Counts are mine,
re-taken at `f9a9e76fee`; they match the dispatching seat's independent reading.

| first segment | entries | old whitelist | disposition |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `packages` / `scripts` / `examples` / `content` / `skills` | 86 / 55 / 18 / 16 / 4 | recognised | unchanged |
| `docs` | 3 | **not recognised** | **added** |
| `.claude` | 1 | **not recognised** | **added** |
| `.github` | 1 | **not recognised** | **deferred, declared — see below** |
| `sdui.manifest.json` | 1 | not recognised | a repo-root **file**, not a directory — see below |

`apps` is declared 0 times and stays in the list: the note says a glob *can* name it, and
`apps/` is a real top-level directory. Not a defect, untouched.

## Why `.github` is deferred rather than added

Recognising `.github` flat turns this gate **red on two literals that are over-collection
rather than reads**:

| file | line | literal | what it actually is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages/cli/test/scaffold-ci-script-parity.test.ts` | 17 | `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | inside a **block comment**. The file's real read is line 74, a reconstructed path under `packages/`, already declared |
| `packages/create-objectstack/src/template-consistency.test.ts` | 376 | `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | `expect(scaffolded).toContain(...)` — an assertion about the **scaffolded project's** contents |

Neither test opens this repo's own workflow. Both literals collide with it because a
scaffolded project's CI file has the same repo-relative spelling, and `statSync` then confirms
the collision as a real file. The declaration this gate would demand folds every edit of our CI
workflow into two packages' test hashes, to hash a file neither one reads.

Per the dispatch's stop-line I have **not** fixed those two and have **not** shrunk the
whitelist to chase green. `.github` sits in `TOP_LEVEL_DIRECTORIES_PENDING` carrying that
reason, and the battery pins the map's exact keys, so the deferral is declared and loud rather
than silent. **The disposition is the dispatching seat's call.**

Worth recording: `.github` is **not invisible** meanwhile. The reconstruction half already
rosters `.github/workflows/scaffold-e2e.yml` for `create-objectstack`, declared on
`create-objectstack#test`. What is deferred is the **flat** spelling alone.

## The fourth shape — `sdui.manifest.json`, a repo-root file

The note promises "every top-level **directory**". `sdui.manifest.json` is a repo-root file, so
it is a different shape, and my judgement is to **scope the note to directories and make the
omission loud** rather than fold it into the same regex.

The cost of the alternative is concrete. A directory anchors the match on its own name followed
by `/`, which is what separates `docs/x.md` from prose. A repo-root file's whole repo-relative
path is a **bare filename**, indistinguishable from any other quoted string; the cheapest rule
that would reach `sdui.manifest.json` — collect a quoted dotted word — also collects
`package.json`, which `statSync` then confirms as a real repo-root file. Every test that merely
names that string would roster it, and the over-collection this collector calls harmless stops
being harmless: it would force a declaration on a file nothing reads.

So `TURBO_ROOT_FILE_INPUTS` pins the repo-root files `turbo.json` declares today and the battery
asserts the live reading equals it — a **second** one reds here instead of arriving unnoticed.

## Readings

All taken at base `f9a9e76fee`. Gate exit codes captured before any pipe.

**Collector, fed directly (printed, not counted).** Before to after:

```
'docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.md'   []  ->  ['docs/audits/...']
'docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/grid.json'             []  ->  ['docs/qa/...']
'.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md'       []  ->  ['.claude/skills/...']
'.github/workflows/scaffold-e2e.yml'                     []  ->  []          (pending, declared)
'sdui.manifest.json'                                     []  ->  []          (repo-root file)
'scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs'      ['scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs']  (unchanged, lit)
'content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx'  ['content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx']  (unchanged, lit)
'zzqq/nope.md'                                           []  ->  []          (dark)
'.zzqq/nope.md'                                          []  ->  []          (dark)
```

**DARK, whole tree, at literal granularity** — every (package, literal) the collector rosters,
dumped from `findEscapingPackages()` before and after:

- before **219** rows, after **220** rows
- **removed: 0** — every already-visible literal keeps its verdict, verbatim
- added: exactly one, the bright control proving the new list sees something real —
  `@objectstack/plugin-auth  docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/identity-auth.json`
  (named by `checklist-refusal-envelope-consistency.test.ts`, already inside that package's
  declared `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json`)
- whole-tree gate output is byte-identical before and after: `OK: 29 package(s) read outside
  themselves ... 13 walked root(s) judged, 3 on ACCEPTED_WALK_RADII; 2023 test file(s) ...`

**LIT, both directions, one per directory.** Each injects a flat literal into a test that
already escapes, in a package whose declared globs are known, so no `turbo.json` edit is needed.
Mutations restored after every leg and the restore proven by blob hash, not by exit code:

| leg | host | literal | expected | got |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `docs` undeclared | plugin-auth | `docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md` | red | **exit 1**, names the file |
| `docs` declared | plugin-auth | `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/automation.json` | green | **exit 0** |
| `.claude` undeclared | spec | `.claude/launch.json` | red | **exit 1**, names the file |
| `.claude` declared | spec | `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` | green | **exit 0** |
| `.github` pending | plugin-auth | `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | green | **exit 0** |
| `.github` promoted | plugin-auth | same, `.github` temporarily in the list | red | **exit 1**, names all three |

The last pair is the honest reading for the deferred case: the flat collector stays green on
`.github` **because the entry is pending**, not because it cannot see — promoting the entry reds
it immediately.

**Self-test:** 229 cases before, **255** after — exactly the +26 the new battery pins. All 14
batteries registered, the 12 pre-existing ones intact (13 were declared before; floor 12 to 13).

## Changeset

`skip-changeset`, measured rather than assumed: no package's `files[]` ships anything under
`scripts/` (checked across every `packages/**`, `apps/*` and `examples/*` manifest, with a
positive control reading `packages/spec`'s real `files[]` back). Nothing published moves.

## Acceptance notes — noted, not filed

- `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/live-dialect-matrix.budget.test.ts:107` genuinely reads
  `join(repoRoot(), '.github/workflows/ci.yml')`, and this gate cannot see that file **at all**:
  its `repoRoot()` (line 38) is a hand-rolled `for(;;)` walk rather than one of the recognised
  `findUp` seed spellings, so the file yields no escape and contributes nothing. That read is
  undeclared today. It is a **different mechanism** from this card (seed recognition, not the
  top-level whitelist) and is reported to the dispatching seat rather than fixed here.

Refs: #18340, #15565, and the `skills/` precedent recorded in this gate's own header note.
